scope_status: Implementation-safe account constraints; complete rate windows are controlled by delivery/supply source intersection, not this common-rules ledger.

D17.tariff_eligibility: Single-phase residences, single apartments and churches, entire requirements through one meter; separately metered noncommercial barns/sheds on residential premises also qualify.
D17.initial_study_scope: Ordinary single-phase residential secondary account, one meter, no special contract/auxiliary service/tax exemption.
D17.D14_residential_definition: Standard secondary voltage, not exceeding400amps; primary use residential, incidental nonresidential portion no greater than residential portion.
D17.supply: G10 Standard Offer only; AGS/G9 excluded from initial scope

D19.tariff_eligibility: Secondary nonresidential customer for lighting/power, all electric service at one premises location; any secondary-voltage portion invokes D19.
D19.initial_study_scope: Ordinary single-phase metered secondary; no primary-voltage metering adjustment, unmetered service, county fair/agricultural society special provision, special connected-load determination, emergency/auxiliary agreement or tax exemption.
D19.supply: G10 Standard Offer only; AGS/G9 excluded from initial scope
D19.minimum: Customer Charge for regular complete monthly bill; source does not authorize generic day/30 proration.

metering_and_calendar.D05_B2: Bills normally rendered monthly; other intervals by customer request and Company agreement. Charges computed monthly with due allowance and adjustments for readings adjusted to monthly basis.
metering_and_calendar.partial_cycles: No numeric fixed-charge/demand proration found in D05/G05/T05. Restrict initial studies to complete calendar months; reject partial cycles and unresolved mixed-rate periods.
metering_and_calendar.transition_2025_11_06: D05 revised effectiveNov6,2025; no adopted source recovered specifying midcycle allocation of base demand, customer/minimum, T08 and percentage riders. November2025 must remain blocked unless stronger source is added.
metering_and_calendar.multi_meter: D05 B9 prohibits combining separate meter/delivery readings absent specific tariff/agreement.
metering_and_calendar.estimate_scope: Real utility may estimate missing readings; simulator must reject missing input intervals rather than create estimates.
metering_and_calendar.G05_T05: G05 B1 and T05 B refer billing/meter/payment toD05; no further rate allocation rule.
metering_and_calendar.measurement_days: Local calendar measurement days for statute; DST23/25hour day remains one calendar day.

D19_demand.current: Greatest30-minute integrated kW; include all intervals unless permitted offpeak designation/election applies.
D19_demand.offpeak_window_if_elected: 20:00–08:00, Saturdays/Sundays and observed NewYear, MemorialDay, IndependenceDay, LaborDay, Thanksgiving, Christmas; weighted75%. Other times100%.
D19_demand.history: 75% of greatest such offpeak or onpeak demand as used for billing in Jun,Jul,Aug,Dec,Jan,Feb within prior11months. Require genuine historical billing-demand records or explicitly established new-service history, never silently zero missing records.
D19_demand.offpeak_election: For demand<1000kW no demand designated offpeak without electing$20/month metering option; minimum1year term then30days notice. Initial ordinary no-election scope treats every current interval as full-weight demand.
D19_demand.special_facilities: Company may use85% total connected load when demand not proportionate to installed facilities; low-load factor provision then unavailable. Initial study excludes this determination.
D19_demand.low_load_factor: D19 caps relevant demand/energy billing for D19 plus T8. Numeric cap and allocation are delivery/supply-ledger values; do not exclude ordinary low-load cases merely to avoid selector modeling.
D19_demand.minimum: Monthly minimum is customer charge, not an invented minimumkW.

excise_tax.tariff: D33 Fourth Revised, effective2018-10-01, filed case15-1830-EL-AIR order2018-09-26; identical D33 in assembledJune2025 book and current adopted index.
excise_tax.basis: kWh distributed through utility meter; for nonexport model use gross utility-importkWh, not native behind-meter load or net-after-credit money.
excise_tax.CAT_gross_up: None stated byAESD33 or D05/D15/G05/T05; do not import ToledoSKT grossup or apply generic0.26% wholebill adder.5751.03 defines taxpayer tax rate, not an AES retail billing component.
excise_tax.cap: No ordinaryD17/D19 maximum found; reviewed entireD33 andORC5727.81.
excise_tax.excluded: Federal/uranium/qualified-regeneration/qualified-manufacturing exemptions; special self-assessing regime underC; special exemption claims. Ordinary imported electricity remains distinct from own generated selfconsumption.
excise_tax.calculator_conflict: Official commercial calculator normalizes25–35day bills to1 and uses2000/15000 bands, differing from statute fornon30days. Use calculator tax benchmark only for exactly30days; statutory detailed-tariff contract controls modeled non30days and label discrepancy.

other_taxes.sales_tax: ORC5739.02(B)(7):electricity delivered through wires exempt.2023 authenticated andcurrentSep30,2025 versions retained. No generic Ohio sales tax percentage.
other_taxes.CAT: ORC5751.03 rate0.0026 is taxpayer grossreceiptstax; no independent AES line-item authority found.
other_taxes.local: No separate municipal/franchise percentage verified. Initial scope requires ordinary jurisdiction/account with no separate local adder; do not infer local tax from sales tax tables.
